meta.strategy: Bi-weekly rolling GMMA k-NN (GEAR/BBOZ) with rule-based confirmation filters

model.filterGate: GEAR is the default position; BBOZ is entered either via all 4 filters unanimous, or via the volatility regime override
filters: [BBOZ gate] GMMA trend alignment (short/long EMA group centers ordered by >0.1% bearish)
[BBOZ gate] 20-day relative strength of the underlying is negative
[BBOZ gate] BBOZ.AX volume at least 80% of its trailing 20-day average
[BBOZ gate] pullback entry: price within 3.5% of the short EMA group, not an extended move
model.volatilityGuard: three overrides, independent of the BBOZ gate, checked every session in this order: (1) fast breakdown -- forces BBOZ immediately whenever price closes below its own 20-day MA, regardless of volatility regime or the 50-day MA; (2) failing that, 20-day MA vs 50-day MA crossover -- forces GEAR if the 20-day MA is still below the 50-day MA (price has reclaimed the 20-day MA, or (1) above would have fired instead); (3) failing that, whenever 10-day realized volatility exceeds 1.5x its own trailing 60-day baseline, forces BBOZ if price is above its 50-day MA (topping pattern), else forces GEAR (oversold bounce) -- no CASH state produced
